releaseClaim.currentCapabilities: Contract adoption via canonical decision writer; deterministic READY/BLOCKED/REJECT-* readiness; stage-gate semantic handoff validation with contract-bound identity at Plan→Execute; closed-phase dispatch refusal; terminal evaluator with PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED disposition, budget predicate, bound idempotent replay; next-phase reflection guard with explicit operator authorization escape hatch; Claude and Codex payload parity.

scenarioMatrix.oracle: ADOPTED decision recorded via canonical writer; readiness READY; identity-bound plan handoff passes stageGate('execute'); close-eval records PHASE-CLOSED; replay is ALREADY-CLOSED
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: same fixture without the adoption decision is BLOCKED, not READY
scenarioMatrix.fixtures: scratch root with .kbd-orchestrator, status-file/decision-sink disclosed fixtures (unit); real canonical writer for this phase's own adoption (real path)

scenarioMatrix.name: Missing mandatory criteria block readiness

scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: adding the missing criterion flips the same fixture to READY
scenarioMatrix.evidence: boundary-results.json entries BG-03/BG-04 + phase-readiness unit tests

scenarioMatrix.name: Stale digest rejection and amendment lineage
scenarioMatrix.oracle: digest mismatch => REJECT-STALE (4); amendment without --supersedes => exit 4 with zero writes; with correct --supersedes => ADOPTED with lineage; superseded-chain readiness validates against the live decision
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: unauthorized in-place byte change is REJECT-STALE, never silently re-adopted
scenarioMatrix.evidence: boundary-results.json entries BG-05/BG-08 + contract-adopt/phase-readiness unit tests

scenarioMatrix.name: Identity rejection (project/run/phase mismatch)
scenarioMatrix.oracle: projectId/runId/phaseId disagreement => REJECT-IDENTITY (3) at readiness; wrong-run evidence => BLOCKED evidence-run-mismatch at close
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: matching identity passes the same fixtures
scenarioMatrix.evidence: boundary-results.json entries BG-06/BG-07 + phase-readiness/phase-close-eval unit tests

scenarioMatrix.name: Plan→Execute gate semantics (#60)
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: lib/kbd/stage-gate.mjs stageGate (the transition used by kbd-execute/kbd-plan)
scenarioMatrix.oracle: plan handoff without identity => blocked; incomplete identity fields named; handoff phaseId disagreement blocked; identity-bound handoff + READY contract passes; CLOSED phase refuses execute dispatch; guard status 2 is never treated as success
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: pre-#60 handoff (no identity) that previously passed now blocks
scenarioMatrix.fixtures: scratch phase dirs; status-file fixture for canonical decisions

scenarioMatrix.name: Terminal evaluator refusal classes and budget predicate (#59)
scenarioMatrix.oracle: FAIL oracle => verdict FAIL (3) never closes; missing/stale/wrong-run/digest-mismatched evidence => BLOCKED (2); missing accounting => BLOCKED; exceeded budget => BLOCKED; at-ceiling closes with exhaustion note; unknown-class values not enforced; NOT_EXERCISED never counts as PASS; bound historical closure alone authorizes ALREADY-CLOSED
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: a FAIL result can never produce PHASE-CLOSED; stale evidence is refused even when a bound historical closure exists
scenarioMatrix.fixtures: scratch roots; real production-source file under digest-keyed freshness

scenarioMatrix.name: No unauthorized successor phase (#59)
scenarioMatrix.oracle: stage not reflection-complete => refusal, zero mutation; missing reflection.md => refusal; --allow-incomplete-reflection records explicit operator authorization and is the only continuation path
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: reflection recommendation text alone never creates or activates a phase

scenarioMatrix.oracle: --check reports no drift; packaged kbd-contract-adopt/kbd-phase-readiness-check/kbd-phase-close-eval scripts and lib/kbd modules ship in both Claude and Codex payloads; packaged readiness script runs standalone (BLOCKED on empty scratch root)
